body.name: \widehat\zeta_i
body.def: write \(\bar e=N^{-1}\sum_j\widehat e_j\), \(\widehat z_{m,i}=\widehat e_i-\bar e\), and \(\widehat z_{v,i}=\widehat e_i\circ\widehat e_i-N^{-1}\sum_j\widehat e_j\circ\widehat e_j\); then \(\widehat\zeta_i=(\widehat L\widehat z_{m,i},\widehat A_v\{\widehat z_{v,i}-\widehat\sigma^2\widehat Q_\beta\widehat L\widehat z_{m,i}\},\delta_{(Y_{i0},X_i)}-\widehat P_{0X})\)
